  \begingroup

  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following vitamins is required for fatty acid b-oxidation?}{Which of the following vitamins is required for collagen synthesis?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Niacin
    \item Riboflavin
    \item Thiamin
    \item Vitamin C
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following will increase in vitamin D deficiency?}{Which of the following will increase in obstructive bone disease?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item The plasma concentration of prothrombin
    \item The plasma concentration of preprothrombin
    \item The plasma activity of alkaline phosphatase
    \item The plasma activity of acid phosphatase
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of these factors increases the risk for postmenopausal breast cancer?}{Which of these factors is the richest dietary source of long-chain omega-3 fats?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Red meat
    \item Dietary fat
    \item Fish
    \item Obesity
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{What is leptin resistance?}{What is congenital leptin deficiency?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Deficiency of leptin caused by a mutation in the leptin gene
    \item Lack of leptin release from the adipose tissue
    \item High concentrations of leptin without reduction in energy intake
    \item Low concentrations of leptin with increased energy intake
\end{enumerate}
\item What enzyme is responsible for copying methylation marks from the parental to the daughter
strand of DNA during replication?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item DNMT1
    \item DNMT3a
    \item DNMT3b
    \item DNMT3L
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}

\item True or False: Food balance sheets provide detailed information on food waste and consumption distribution within a country.
\item True or False: Iodine and vitamin C deficiencies are known to cause anaemia in individuals across various age groups.
\item True or False: Lactobacilli are primarily responsible for the initiation of dental caries in the mouth.
\item True or False: ATP is the immediate source of chemical energy used by skeletal muscles for contraction.
\end{enumerate}
